title: 把燈留給你
subject: leaving a light on for someone
caption: Gospel soul sung in Mandarin. Hammond organ with a rotating speaker, upright piano, tambourine on the backbeat, hand claps, bass and a live drum kit. A deep male bass voice leads with warm sustained phrasing and a full choir answers every line in call and response, building to stacked harmonies and ad-libs over the final chorus, with a key change into the last repeat. Recorded in a live room with natural bleed and gospel-room reverb. 96 BPM, A-flat major. Communal, rising, hopeful.
lyrics:
[Intro - Organ]

[Verse 1]
你走的那天沒有說幾點回
我就沒有問
只是把玄關那盞燈
換成了不會燒壞的

[Pre-Chorus]
(留著) 留著
(等著) 等著

[Chorus]
我把燈留給你
你什麼時候回來都看得見路
這條巷子很黑
可是我這一段是亮的

[Verse 2]
鄰居問我電費貴不貴
我說貴
他說那你還開
我說我還開

[Bridge - Choir]
(還開著) 還開著
(還亮著) 還亮著

[Chorus - key change]
我把燈留給你
你什麼時候回來都看得見路
這條巷子很黑
可是我這一段是亮的

[Outro]
一直亮著
一直亮著
